title: How to Plant a Garden
text: If you want to grow your own vegetables, follow these simple steps. First, choose a sunny spot in your yard with good soil. Next, dig small holes and drop one seed into each hole. Then cover the seeds gently with dirt and water them well. Check your garden every day, and pull out any weeds you see. In a few weeks, tiny green sprouts will start to poke through the soil. With patience and care, your garden will soon be full of fresh vegetables.
